title: Modal
description: Dialog surface that displays slotted content above the scene.

triggerLabel.description: Label for the button that opens the modal.

open.description: Whether the modal is currently visible.

content.description: Modal body content. Usually contains a form or focused interaction.

opened.title: Opened
opened.description: Emitted when the modal is opened.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: Emitted when the modal is closed.
